title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity + v1.196.1 version bump
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth/retries behavior and streaming ergonomics, fix subtle divergence that caused auth header refresh to behave differently across runtimes, and bump SDK package versions to v1.196.1. This PR unifies the retry backoff config and default values, standardizes streaming iterator callbacks across languages, and updates client constructors to accept the new unified AuthProvider interface. Changes include API surface adjustments and internal adapters to preserve backward compatibility where possible. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth provider interface and default refresh behavior - [x] Implement shared retry/backoff defaults with override hooks - [x] Improve streaming API ergonomics (python generator, ts async iterator, go channel helper) - [x] Add cross-language integration tests and unit tests - [x] Bump SDK package versions to v1.196.1 and update changelogs - [x] Document migration guidance in SDK docs Notes: Kept shims for legacy AuthTokenSource usage with deprecation warnings; migration guide added to docs. No breaking changes for common usage patterns but advanced custom auth implementations should follow new AuthProvider hooks. CI observed a flaky e2e streaming test that was rerun and passed; all checks green before merge.
commits: unify: auth provider interface and adapters (python/ts/go)
feat(sdk): shared retry/backoff defaults + override hooks
refactor(streaming): unify iterator ergonomics across sdks
test: add cross-language integration tests for auth/retries/streaming
chore: bump package versions to v1.196.1 and update changelogs
review_comments: Ethan Park: Can we avoid allocating a new goroutine per stream in the Go shim? Suggested using a single goroutine with an internal fan-out; author: addressed with a buffered channel and pooled goroutine approach.
Sanjay Patel: Please add a unit test for retry backoff jitter edge case; author: added a deterministic jitter test and documented randomness seed in test harness.
Lena Fischer: Small nits on TypeScript typings for streaming next() return types; author: updated types and added interoperability tests with TS consumer example.
QA: e2e streaming test failed once due to env flake (socket timeout), rerun passed - tracking in ENG-2060.
release_notes: SDKs: Unified auth provider interface across Python/TypeScript/Go with consistent retry/backoff defaults; improved streaming ergonomics (python generator, TS async iterator, Go channel helper); package versions bumped to v1.196.1. Migration guidance added to SDK docs. No breaking changes for most users; custom auth providers should migrate to the new AuthProvider hooks.
